question: The Hundru falls are formed by the river ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subarnarekha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Hundru falls located in Ranchi **are formed by the river **Subernrekha**.
 
• It falls from a **height of 320 feet **and forms one of the highest waterfalls of state **Jharkhand.**
 
• It is located at **45km distance from the main city of Ranchi.**
 
• **Hundru falls **has great tourist significance due to its scenic beauty
 
• Its base forms a pool **which is a famous picnic spot**.
 
• The city of** Jamshedpur having the TATA industry** is situated on the bank of river **Subarnarekha.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Umngot River- **It is also known by the name of** Dawki River which flows through Dawki town** at the bottom of the West Jaintia Hills district in the Indian** state of Meghalaya.**
 
• **Tsangpo- **The river **Brahmaputra is called with the name the Yarlung Tsangpo **when it enters **Tibet. **It originates from the **Kailash range of the Himalayas.**
 
• **Teesta- **Teesta River at rises from **Pauhunri Mountain of eastern Himalayas and** flows from** Sikkim and West Bengal **and enters the Bay of Bengal after passing through neighbouring country **Bangladesh**.
